why: C is the real init_database writing the header page; A and D are test stand-ins that also allocate extra pages, B only reads the header.
B drives step over a slice then finalizes; A is only a finalize impl.
B compiles a SELECT core into a plan node; the others are test helpers wrapping a Window node.
A looks up the memoized recompiled triggers; B stores them and C builds the key.
D parses an insert string and plans it; A-C are parser pieces only.
B returns a table's column names; the others return affinities.
A classifies an operand as left-only/right-only; C checks one range only; B and D are about column-name references in DDL.
D rejects an identifier char directly after a numeric literal.
Both decode the rootpage column of a schema record; A also assembles overflow, B decodes a raw record.
Both compute page size minus reserved space; A on a header struct, B from the pager's page 1.
B is the OnceLock global builtin registry; C builds it eagerly and A wraps it.
B drains input into groups, finalizes and applies HAVING; A is an end-to-end test.
Both implement exact per-storage-class Value equality; B is documented and public, A is a test helper.
B is the helper asserting the root is an Update node; A is a test doing it inline.
A is the library varint decoder; B is a test-local copy that panics on short input.
B builds the WITHOUT ROWID PK-first storage permutation; C applies it; A and D are order/compare logic.
A adds the integer argument to running state; C is a sum handling all types; B only counts.
C runs ANALYZE end to end into sqlite_stat1; B computes the rows and D queues a job.
D streams the left against a hashed right key set keeping present/absent rows; A is an ordinary hash join.
A takes exactly name and declared type; B also takes optional collation.
D compiles a FROM subquery into a materialized CteScan; A dispatches to it.
D builds a synthetic TVF column with BINARY collation; the others are generic test ColumnDef/TableDef builders.
C maps the offset-56 code to a TextEncoding; A and D test it, B decodes the whole header.
D applies per-side affinity then compares for equality; C compares without coercion, A only builds such an expression in a test.
A creates a MemPager and reserves page 1 so later ids do not collide; others edit/read the header or count allocations.
A skips whitespace and line/block comments; B is the tokenizer loop that calls a trivia skipper.
B rewrites CREATE TABLE text with a column removed; D extracts an ADD COLUMN fragment, C is a drop-check test helper.
A and D both return the committed db size at a WAL snapshot mark; B is a plain current page count.
D looks up a view across catalogs in search order; A/B/C resolve which namespace owns a name, not the definition.
A renders a column DEFAULT back to SQL text; D renders general expressions as labels, B/C are test helpers.
B wraps the plan with DISTINCT, ORDER BY and LIMIT; A is a test helper walking those nodes.
B is the strftime format-specifier renderer; A/D render fixed formats, C produces the civil breakdown.
A drops the overlay and releases the write lock; B is the engine-level ROLLBACK that delegates to pagers and reloads catalogs.
C looks up a view by database index and name; A lacks the database, B/D are table lookups.
B reads the accumulator's current result without consuming it; A is a test aggregate's finalize.
B is the rowid/_rowid_/oid alias predicate; A is an affinity test about INTEGER PRIMARY KEY.
D compiles an expression subquery under its parent scope; A compiles trigger-action selects, B is the top-level planner.
C implements ON UPDATE actions on child rows; A/B/D are tests of it.
C starts a WAL builder emitting the header and seeding the running checksum; B only builds the header.
A and B both scan an index for a UNIQUE conflict under non-BINARY collation (WITHOUT ROWID vs rowid); C/D are unrelated tests.
B is is_commit on a WAL frame; others concern checkpoints, refresh, journal sync.
A pushes star columns as projections with names and source ASTs; B gives names only, C is the UPDATE RETURNING variant.
Both overwrite a big-endian integer at an offset in a page; A fixed 4 bytes, B variable width.
Both compare row results via Debug formatting because Value lacks PartialEq.
A implements VACUUM INTO a target file; B is a test helper writing raw pages.
